name: asyncapi-security-check
description: Read an AsyncAPI 3.0 or 2.6 document (JSON or YAML) and report what makes an event-driven integration unsafe or fragile: servers with no security or a plain protocol where a secure one exists, credentials in the query, messages without a payload schema, request/reply without a correlation id, operations without a channel, unused channels and unresolved references. Each finding has its JSON pointer and line and quotes the specification or the protocol page. Fetches nothing, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
